name: DOBOT Atom
summary: A full-size humanoid from Shenzhen's Dobot, a maker of desktop and collaborative robot arms. Atom uses a straight-knee walking gait the company says cuts walking energy by more than 40%, and leans on Dobot's manipulation heritage for precise tasks like electronics soldering and micro-assembly.
notable: High-precision assembly from an arm-robotics maker; ~US$27.5k
